notes.title: Frozenbyte 15th Anniversary and Update to Shadwen!
notes.notes:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/PmJO07R.jpg[/img]

To celebrate our 15th anniversary we are having [url=http://store.steampowered.com/search/?developer=Frozenbyte]our games[/url] on sale and added an update to Shadwen! 

The update, called Escape from the Castle, adds 14 re-worked levels to Shadwen for free to all platforms: Windows, Linux and Mac. You can read more from [url=http://www.frozenbyte.com/2016/08/shadwen-updated-with-additional-levels-and-our-15th-anniversary-sale/]our blog[/url] or go to Shadwen's Steam page from [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/425210/0]here[/url].

Don't forget to take advance of the bundle prices for example with [url=http://store.steampowered.com/bundle/690/]Frozenbyte Collection[/url]. Its price adjusts if you already own some of the games!

We also made a video to show our progress from our first game, Shadowgrounds to Shadwen. You can find it below.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KmZ9OTmBLjQ

Thank you all for supporting us for so long! :)

[img]http://i.imgur.com/vNEibtO.jpg[/img]
